title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke University on 1982-04-02
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2025 > DDi Codec (dolby B) > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (w/ Bass EQ) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: DDi codec lifts the recording to good quality, showcasing a monstrous He's Gone → Truckin' → Other One sequence.
ai_review.review: The reviewer gives this tape five stars, praising the improved sound after applying the DDi decoding and highlighting the last‑era “good ole fashioned” monster of He’s Gone into Truckin’ and The Other One. While no specific source type is mentioned, the performance itself is described as a must‑listen showcase of classic Dead improvisation.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; it rates the show and recording highly, indicating an excellent performance and a noticeably improved listening experience after using the DDi codec.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer credits the DDi codec for making a big difference in clarity and overall listenability; no explicit comments on soundboard vs. audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful late‑show sequence (He’s Gone → Truckin' → The Other One) is highlighted as a classic, high‑energy jam that drives the set forward.
